sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use the Gemini app on Mac</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p><span>You can interact with Gemini, Google's AI assistant, directly from your Mac desktop. The Gemini app provides quick access to AI features, allowing you to get help with writing, brainstorming, coding, and more, without needing to open a web browser.</span></p>

<h2><span>What you need to use the Gemini app on Mac</span></h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>A personal Google Account you manage on your own, or a work or school account that your administrator has enabled Gemini.
    <ul>
      <li>If you’re using a work or school account, <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100#access" rel="noopener">check if you have a plan or license that includes access to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>A Mac running macOS Sequoia (15.0) or later&nbsp;with Apple Silicon,&nbsp;8 GB of RAM or more, and at least 200 MB of available disk space for installation.</li>
  <li>A stable internet connection is required to use Gemini's features.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>Download and install the Gemini app on Mac</h2>

<div><p>Follow these steps to download and install the Gemini app on your Mac:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Open your web browser and go to gemini.google/mac.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Download for Mac</strong>. The Gemini app installer file (<code>.dmg</code>) will download to your <code>Downloads</code> folder.</li>
  <li>Once the download is complete, open the <code>.dmg</code> file.</li>
  <li>In the window that appears, drag the Gemini<strong> </strong>icon <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2"> to your <strong>Applications</strong> folder.</li>
  <li>Open your <strong>Applications</strong> folder and double-click Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Sign in with your Google Account if prompted.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>For quick access, you can also use the keyboard shortcut <code>Option + Space</code> to bring up the Gemini chat window after the app is installed and running. You can customize this shortcut in the app's settings.</li>
  <li>Some features may not work if your Gemini app on Mac is out of date. To check for updates, open the Gemini app on your Mac. At the top, click <strong>Gemini</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;<strong>Check for Updates</strong>. If an update is available, click <strong>Install update</strong>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>What you can do with the Gemini app on Mac</h2>

<div><p>The Gemini app for Mac brings the power of Google's AI directly to your desktop, making it easier to bring AI assistance throughout your day.</p>

<p>Here's what you can do with the Gemini app:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Get quick answers:</strong> Instantly ask questions and get information without opening a browser.</li>
  <li><strong>Draft content:</strong> Generate ideas, write emails, craft documents, or create engaging social media posts.</li>
  <li><strong>Summarize information:</strong> Quickly get the main points from long articles, web pages, or documents.</li>
  <li><strong>Brainstorm ideas:</strong> Use Gemini as a creative partner to explore new concepts and generate innovative solutions.</li>
  <li><strong>Get coding help:</strong> Write code, debug, or understand complex programming concepts in various languages.</li>
  <li><strong>Analyze images:</strong> Upload images and ask Gemini questions about them, or use them to spark new ideas.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> To get more personalized responses, you can share your window with Gemini. In Gemini, click Add files and tools <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc"><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Share window <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/8Ul-ixqdTF3lQ_QyElBV-R-MqV_kCz33hjWyC0hz8NgsMGSrO9leVZ_1zLKJQqpN27_e=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/8Ul-ixqdTF3lQ_QyElBV-R-MqV_kCz33hjWyC0hz8NgsMGSrO9leVZ_1zLKJQqpN27_e">.</p>

<h2>Chat with Gemini on Mac with your voice</h2>

<div>You can chat with Gemini using your voice in two ways:&nbsp;
<ul>
  <li>Use the Mic <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/BLE--0LqsG3hFkUS7EoL543RzEeUaOfi2zJj2hL8gNpBEvZSivMCmTRq5mgUgvHys6FX=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/BLE--0LqsG3hFkUS7EoL543RzEeUaOfi2zJj2hL8gNpBEvZSivMCmTRq5mgUgvHys6FX"> to dictate a prompt to Gemini in the Gemini app.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>Use Speak to Window&nbsp;<img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/8dxsu5TtRJ3lijjmXwgmcFw2b2YvXbiho5SO" width="Auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml"> to let Gemini help you work in your other apps.</li>
</ul>

<h4>Standard dictation:&nbsp;</h4>

<p>When you know exactly what to say to Gemini, click the Mic&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/BLE--0LqsG3hFkUS7EoL543RzEeUaOfi2zJj2hL8gNpBEvZSivMCmTRq5mgUgvHys6FX=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/BLE--0LqsG3hFkUS7EoL543RzEeUaOfi2zJj2hL8gNpBEvZSivMCmTRq5mgUgvHys6FX"> to say your prompt. When you’re done, click Send&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa"> to share your prompt with Gemini.</p>

<h4>Speak to Window:&nbsp;</h4>

<p>When you want to use Gemini to shape, edit, and create content in other apps, use Speak to Window mode. With Speak to Window, Gemini will refine and clean-up your audio, share context of the highlighted window and any highlighted content directly to Gemini, and add a response to the active window.&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<h3><a id="stw" name="stw"></a>Use Speak to Window</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important</strong>: For now, Speak to Window is only available in English. Speak to Window is rolling out over time, so it may not be available to you yet.</p>

<p>When you use Speak to Window, Gemini uses intelligent context to help you work across your Mac. Gemini infers whether you want to add text to the active window or take action. For example, if you highlight meeting notes, Gemini includes that info to draft an email in your Gmail window. Or you can describe an image you want to create, and Gemini will add it where your cursor is.&nbsp;</p>

<p>To use Speak to Window, press and hold the <strong>fn</strong>&nbsp;key. Gemini will start working as you speak. When you release <strong>fn</strong>, your query is submitted.&nbsp;<br>
  <br>
  <strong>Tip</strong>: You can also tap <strong>fn</strong>&nbsp;twice or open Gemini and click Speak to Window <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/8dxsu5TtRJ3lijjmXwgmcFw2b2YvXbiho5SO" width="Auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml">, then tap <strong>fn</strong>&nbsp;again to submit your query.&nbsp;<br>
  <br>
  <strong>You can use Speak to Window to</strong>:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Dictate text</strong>: Speak naturally. Gemini will lightly clean up your words, like removing any “Um” sounds, and drop the text at your cursor.&nbsp;</li>
  <li><strong>Refine text</strong>: Highlight text in any app and tell Gemini how to change it, like shortening the text or changing the tone.&nbsp;</li>
  <li><strong>Summarize files</strong>: Highlight documents, PDFs, or images on your desktop and ask Gemini to extract key details.</li>
  <li><strong>Generate images</strong>: Describe a visual prompt by voice to generate and insert images directly into your workspace. &nbsp;</li>
  <li><strong>Work across multiple apps or windows</strong>: Select content in one window, start Speak to Window, then switch to another window. If you use multiple windows, Gemini will take action in the window that’s active when the response is ready.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
  <strong>Tips</strong>:&nbsp;</p>

<ul>
  <li>To stop a Speak to Window session, tap the ESC key or click Close <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/epx0EI4hsZkE_9nvespXdYVrEKcQMDive5e5UH4p0d2wfwQvEzxhQb0xUOvnIm4Swg=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/epx0EI4hsZkE_9nvespXdYVrEKcQMDive5e5UH4p0d2wfwQvEzxhQb0xUOvnIm4Swg">.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>To give Gemini specific context on text or an image, highlight it, then start Speak to Window. Deselect the info after starting Speak to Window so Gemini won’t replace it.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin">&nbsp;</div>

<div class="no-margin">&nbsp;</div>
<a class="zippy" id="stw_speech" name="stw_speech">Choose how Gemini works with your speech</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>You can choose how Gemini uses what you say in Speak to Window. When the&nbsp;<strong>Use reasoning</strong>&nbsp;setting is on, Gemini will try to recognize whether you are giving Gemini instructions or want to dictate text. When <strong>Use reasoning</strong> is off, Gemini will write what you say and clean up the text, like removing any pauses or sounds, like “um.”&nbsp;</p>

<p>To turn <strong>Use reasoning</strong> off or on:</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your Mac, open Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top menu bar, click <strong>Gemini</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Speak to Window <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/8dxsu5TtRJ3lijjmXwgmcFw2b2YvXbiho5SO" width="Auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml">.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>Turn <strong>Use reasoning</strong> on <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/KqijgcUmA1-8BvhhJtFLjvm-et0odaqT-S3C6g1NAqpkPfRI7uWtl9rcg0IBTVSiFME=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/KqijgcUmA1-8BvhhJtFLjvm-et0odaqT-S3C6g1NAqpkPfRI7uWtl9rcg0IBTVSiFME">&nbsp;or off <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/B_qS32AqHelobhLdFSN_oB5VLFAp9UF4ITShWbuWOKbohQRd_S6onkhq4xVuUBINsA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/B_qS32AqHelobhLdFSN_oB5VLFAp9UF4ITShWbuWOKbohQRd_S6onkhq4xVuUBINsA">.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="keyboard" name="keyboard">Customize keyboard settings for Speak to Window</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Use keyboard shortcuts to start Speak to Window across your Mac.&nbsp;</p>

<p>To customize Speak to Window keyboard shortcuts:&nbsp;</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your Mac, open Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top menu bar, click <strong>Gemini</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;<strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;Speak to Window <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/8dxsu5TtRJ3lijjmXwgmcFw2b2YvXbiho5SO" width="Auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml">.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>Choose the type of keyboard shortcut you want to customize:
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tap to speak keyboard shortcut&nbsp;</strong></li>
      <li><strong>Hold while speaking keyboard shortcut</strong></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>At the right, choose which keyboard shortcut you want to use.&nbsp;</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
